thumb_alt: Web3 privacy protocol brand identity with visual system for decentralized infrastructure product
img_alt: Brand production elements for Web3 privacy protocol including visual identity and content assets
tiles: Visual identity for privacy-first blockchain protocol
Content strategy for developer and consumer audiences
challenge: Privacy protocols are among the most technically complex products in Web3. The branding needed to communicate the value of decentralized identity and data sovereignty to both developers who would build on the protocol and consumers who would benefit from it — two audiences with fundamentally different technical literacy levels.
approach: Created a brand identity system that used visual metaphors for privacy and security without resorting to lock-and-key clichés. The illustration style conveyed both the sophistication of the underlying cryptography and the human benefits of data protection. Content production included technical documentation design, social media templates, and presentation materials adapted for conferences and investor meetings.
result: The brand system successfully served both technical and consumer-facing communications. Developer-focused materials maintained credibility with the crypto community while consumer-facing content made privacy technology feel relevant and urgent. The visual identity established the protocol as a serious player in the decentralized identity space.
